errors.text_span: Es gibt vier Linien, die Datenpunkte darstellen.
errors.evidence: The chart clearly shows three data lines (TSE, TSEC, TSEB), not four.

errors.text_span: erreicht einen Höhepunkt von etwa 1.050 im Jahr 1991
errors.evidence: The peak of the TSE line (purple) in 1991 is just under 1,000, not 1,050.
The TSE line (purple) ends at approximately 500 in 2017, not 850.

errors.text_span: steigt langsam auf etwa 300 im Jahr 1999
errors.evidence: The TSEB line (blue) is at a value of 400 in 1999, not 300.
The TSEB line (blue) ends at a value of approximately 420 in 2017, not 300.

errors.text_span: fällt auf einen Tiefpunkt von etwa 100 im Jahr 2010
errors.evidence: The low point for the TSEC line (green) occurs around 2011 at a value of approximately 50-70, not 100 in 2010.
The TSEC line (green) ends at a value of approximately 100 in 2017, not 150.

The description fails to mention the legend text below the plot which defines the acronyms used for the lines (TSE = Total Support Estimate; TSEC = Transfers from Consumers; TSEB = Transfers from taxpayers).
